date: The Tabuk Expedition, year 9 of the Hijra (630)
title: 24dk3j
The Hadith of the Manzila: at Tabuk, "You are to me as Harun was to Musa"
hook: At Tabuk the Prophet said to Imam Ali, "You are to me as Harun was to Musa."
scenes.0.text: In the 9th year of the Hijra the Byzantines were gathering troops on the border. The summer was hot, there was famine, the road was long. The Prophet set out for **Tabuk** all the same. The army was called the "Army of Hardship." On this expedition the Prophet was to state **Imam Ali**'s standing in one sentence.
scenes.0.art.actors.1.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.1.text: As he set out for Tabuk, the Prophet left **Imam Ali** as his deputy to guard Medina and his family. A deputy is the person who looks after the city in his name. He entrusted the city to the person he trusted most. This was not pushing **Imam Ali** aside.
scenes.1.art.actors.0.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.1.art.actors.1.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.2.text: When the Prophet set out, the hypocrites in Medina whispered: "He left him because he saw him as a burden." A hypocrite is one who appears to believe but opposes from within. **Imam Ali** girded on his weapon and caught up with the army. His heart was hurt. The Prophet's answer was to tell the hurt **Imam Ali** his station.
scenes.2.art.actors.0.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.3.text: **Imam Ali**, having caught up with the army, asked: "Are you leaving me with the children and the women?" The Prophet said: "Are you not content that you should have the same place with me as Harun had with Musa? Except that there is no prophet after me." This saying makes **Imam Ali** brother, vizier and caliph. Vizier means helper. A caliph is one who takes someone's place. Only prophethood is set apart.
scenes.3.art.actors.0.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.3.art.actors.1.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.4.text: In the Qur'an, when Musa goes up to Tur, he says to Harun, "Take my place among my people" (A'râf 7:142). He had also asked, "Give me a helper from my family" (Tâhâ 20:29). The **Manzila**, that is the hadith of station, places this place of Harun on **Imam Ali**. At Ghadir the Prophet will proclaim this place in the desert before everyone.
scenes.5.text: **Imam Ali** is the Prophet's brother, vizier and caliph. The sentence "there is no prophet after me" sets apart only nubuwwa. Nubuwwa means prophethood. The rest of the place is **Imam Ali**'s. This saying would be forgotten at the Saqifa, and at Ghadir it would be repeated before everyone.
scenes.5.art.actors.0.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.6.text: Years later **Mu'awiya** asked Sa'd why he did not curse **Imam Ali**. Sa'd listed three sayings: the **Manzila**, the Khaybar banner, and the Mubahala. The Mubahala is the day of mutual cursing. While the pulpit was asked to curse **Imam Ali**, these three sayings still stood.
scenes.7.text: No battle broke out at Tabuk. The Prophet made agreements and returned to Medina. **Imam Ali** had caught up with him on the road and heard that saying. The city had been left in trust with his deputy **Imam Ali**. Wilayah, that is leadership, was not left empty on this expedition either.
scenes.7.art.actors.0.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
sunni.0.says: The hadith "You are to me as Harun was to Musa."
sunni.1.says: As the Prophet sets out for Tabuk he leaves Imam Ali as deputy in Medina; the Manzila saying.
sunni.2.says: The Manzila hadith with the qualification "there is no prophet after me" (Tabuk); the Mu'awiya-Sa'd conversation.
sunni.3.says: Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas reminds Mu'awiya of three sayings: mawla, Manzila, the Khaybar banner.
shia.0.says: The chains of the Manzila hadith in Shia and Sunni sources and an explanation of its being evidence for the imamate.
disputes.0.title: 1tuz5s
Was the Tabuk arrangement a deputyship or a succession?
disputes.0.sunni: At Tabuk the Prophet left Imam Ali in his place in Medina and spoke the Harun comparison. In the Sunni reading the deputyship is temporary for the length of the expedition; deputies were left on other expeditions too, since Harun died before Musa the saying is not counted as evidence of the caliphate, yet it is still a great virtue.
disputes.0.shia: At Tabuk the Prophet left Imam Ali in his place in Medina and spoke the Harun comparison. In the Shia view Harun is Musa's brother, vizier and caliph; the qualification "except prophethood" shows that the remaining stations were given to Imam Ali.
disputes.1.title: kz4vpp
Is the saying specific to Tabuk, or general?
disputes.1.sunni: The Prophet said this saying at Tabuk so that Imam Ali would not be grieved. In the Sunni reading the saying is limited to that event.
disputes.1.shia: The Prophet said this saying at Tabuk so that Imam Ali would not be grieved. In the Shia view "manzila" is a general position; confining the saying to a single event does not fit its wording.
questions.0: The Prophet said, "There is no prophet after me." What does Harun's remaining place show you in Imam Ali?
questions.1: The Prophet had left deputies on other expeditions too. But he spoke the Harun saying to Imam Ali. How does this closeness sit in your heart?
questions.2: Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas counted the Manzila among Imam Ali's virtues. On hearing this saying, how far does your love for him reach?
summary: At Tabuk the Prophet said to Imam Ali, "You are to me as Harun was to Musa." He also added, "There is no prophet after me." This saying appears in Sunni sources as well (Bukhari, Sahih, no. 3706; Muslim, Sahih, no. 2404). The Shia count it as evidence that Imam Ali is the Prophet's brother, vizier and caliph.
key: «You are to me as Harun was to Musa»
notes.0: The Tabuk expedition was made in the 9th year of the Hijra against the Byzantine threat.
notes.1: The Prophet left Imam Ali as deputy in Medina.
notes.2: He said, «You are to me as Harun was to Musa; except that there is no prophet after me» (Bukhari 3706, Muslim 2404).
notes.3: This saying describes Imam Ali's place after the Prophet.
